readme:
# Veo 3.1 Lite Image to Video

Veo 3.1 Lite image-to-video, the lowest-cost Veo 3.1 tier for high-volume drafts. `image` becomes the first frame and the prompt directs motion, camera, and sound for a 4–8 second clip.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 20,000 characters. |
| `image` | image URL, required | — | First frame. JPEG, PNG, or WebP URL. |
| `duration` | 4 / 6 / 8 | 8 | Output length in seconds. |
| `resolution` | `720p` / `1080p` | `720p` | Sets the per-second rate. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `16:9` / `9:16` | — | Output frame shape. |
| `generate_audio` | boolean | true | Native dialogue, music, and effects; turning it off lowers the rate. |
| `negative_prompt` | string | — | What to avoid. |
| `seed` | integer 0–4294967295 | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |

## Billing

You pay for output seconds, Google's list price. With audio: $0.05 at 720p, $0.08 at 1080p. Without audio: $0.03 / $0.05 respectively.

| Output | 720p | 1080p |
|---|---|---|
| 4s with audio | $0.20 | $0.32 |
| 6s with audio | $0.30 | $0.48 |
| 8s with audio (default) | $0.40 | $0.64 |
| 8s without audio | $0.24 | $0.40 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Describe what moves and what the audio should be, not what is already visible.
- Match `aspect_ratio` to the input image.

## Limits

- One input image; use first-last-frame-to-video to control the ending.
- No 4K on this tier.

## Also on SandBase

Other Veo 3.1 Lite endpoints: `google/veo3.1/lite/text-to-video`, `google/veo3.1/lite/first-last-frame-to-video`, `google/veo3.1/text-to-video`, `google/veo3.1/fast/text-to-video`.
